description: c118 (2026-05-15) save-wire-format-pillar deep coverage: drives the saveLoadAgent JSON parse path end-to-end at boot. The PC port has saveLoadAgent (port/src/savefile.c:367) but zero production call-sites -- Agent Select UI routes through gamefileLoad, not saveLoadAgent (see port/PHASE_D5_PLAN.md:89 for the planned-but-unwired hook). This test uses the new --launch-load-agent <name> CLI fast-path (main.c bootApplyLaunchLoadAgent + bootLaunchLoadAgentTick, wired into pdmain.c::mainTick alongside --debug-mount-bike and --debug-spawn-at). The fast-path latches the agent name at CLI parse time and fires saveLoadAgent on the first frame past lvframenum>=4. The agent_smoke.json v2 fixture is pre-staged at <install>/agent_smoke.json via run.ps1::Copy-SmokeFixtures + --portable. Boot sequence: saveMigrateInit (version 2) -> saveInit (save dir = exeDir under --portable) -> [stage tick reaches lvframenum>=4] -> bootLaunchLoadAgentTick fires -> saveLoadAgent('smoke') opens agent_smoke.json, parses version=2 / name=smoke / counters all zero, populates g_GameFile, returns 0. The harness asserts (1) save subsystem initialised cleanly, (2) the fast-path armed log line on CLI parse, (3) the fast-path consumed result=OK log line after the deferred dispatch, (4) the SAVE: agent 'smoke' loaded line from inside saveLoadAgent itself. Sister of save_init_smoke (inits-only); together they cover the save-wire-format pillar boot path and the JSON parse path.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --no-net + --portable + --skip-intro routes boot through STAGE_CITRAINING (skip-intro shortcut at main.c:1097). The --launch-load-agent CLI parser captures name='smoke' into g_BootLoadAgentName and sets g_BootLoadAgentArmed=1. saveMigrateInit + saveInit fire during main.c init (~lines 956-957) before the bootPool runs, so the save dir is wired by the time the deferred tick gates open. After stage load completes and lvframenum>=4, bootLaunchLoadAgentTick (called from pdmain.c::mainTick) calls saveLoadAgent('smoke') -- this reads <savedir>/agent_smoke.json, validates version=2, parses fields into g_GameFile, returns 0. The harness logs BOOT: --launch-load-agent consumed result=OK and saveLoadAgent itself logs SAVE: agent 'smoke' loaded from <path>.

scripted exit at 15s -- saveInit + saveMigrateInit complete by ~1s on clean install; the deferred saveLoadAgent fires within a few seconds of CI load. 14s headroom covers cold-start variance and asset catalog warm-up.

required_lines: SAVEMIGRATE: Initialized \(0 migrations registered, current save version: 2\)
